fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM80,445. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0008597/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: SPM/equivalent: Five (5) credits including Malay, English, Mathematics, one Science subject (Biology / Physics / Chemistry / General Science / Applied Science), and one other subject. GCE O-Level/equivalent: Grade C in English, Mathematics, one Science subject, and two other subjects. MQF Level-3 Certificate (Health Sciences): Minimum CGPA 2.75. MQF Level-3 Polytechnic Certificate (related fields): Minimum CGPA 2.00. SKM Level-3 (related fields): SPM with one (1) Credit and consolidation programme where necessary. MARA Skills Institute Certificate (MQF Level-3): Minimum CGPA 2.00. UEC: Grade B in three (3) subjects. Other qualifications: Recognised as equivalent by the Government of Malaysia.
